newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Liberty invests 350 mln rand in new hotels.
newsitem.headline: Liberty invests 350 mln rand in new hotels.

text.p: Liberty Life Properties, the property arm of Liberty Life Association, announced on Tuesday it would invest 350 million rand in the development of new hotels in South Africa.
The six new hotels, which would be managed by the Southern Sun Group and fall under the Holiday Inn banner, should bring 1,207 new rooms to the South African market within two years.
"An investment of 350 million rand in the development of new hotels in South Africa by Liberty Life has been announced by its property arm, Liberty Life Properties," the group said in a statement.
"Six new hotels will go some way towards meeting projected increases in demand for accommodation in Cape Town and Gauteng," Southern Sun group managing director Ron Stringfellow said.
Three of the hotels are destined for the Western Cape and three for Gauteng, centred on Johannesburg,
The potential guests have been identified primarily as business travellers, sports groups and the growing international and domestic tourist market, Liberty said.
Construction on the Cape Town project will commence before the year end, with staggered openings for the hotels scheduled from late 1997.
Construction on one of the Gauteng hotels has commenced with work starting on the other two in a few months.
